verification.repository_checked: Local Cultural Brain app working tree, 2026-11-23 (files listed in code_registries, hashed). Not the PythonAnywhere deployment and not a commit-pinned release. Repo landings is presentation-only.
verification.translation_status: Editorial EN labels added for visualization from audited ES descriptions; not source-code canonical IDs.
verification.count_semantics: Counts are entries in local code registries (catalog keys, type tuples, decision and recommendation kinds). They are not a certification of the PythonAnywhere deployment and not a count of complete end-to-end processes.
verification.id_separation: Editorial identifiers (families[].id Fxx, keys[].display_id Fxx/NN, presentation_id, ordinal) are presentation locators. Technical identifiers live only in canonical_* fields. They are never interchangeable; presentation_id 'defer' maps to canonical 'postpone'.
